lines.zh: 我橙色的身子在叶上慢慢挪。
lines.en: My orange body works along the leaf.
I loop up, drop, and gain a segment.

lines.zh: 我在叶面上走，颜色特别响。
lines.en: I cross the leaf face, my color loud.

lines.zh: 我沿着叶缘走，那里好抓。
lines.en: I go along the leaf's edge. Better grip.

lines.zh: 我爬到叶背，歇一歇再走。
lines.en: I climb to the underside, rest, then continue.

lines.zh: 我的头总是先探出去探路。
lines.en: My head goes first to test the way.
I go around the vein. Too tough.

lines.zh: 我朝更暖的那面叶子爬。
lines.en: I crawl toward the warmer leaf.

lines.zh: 我一节一节地推，很费劲。
lines.en: I push segment by segment. Hard work.

lines.zh: 枝条断了半截，我另找路。
lines.en: The twig snapped. I'll find another way.
I go down from the tip, sliding slowly.

lines.zh: 我在叶面上留了一道浅痕。
lines.en: I leave a faint track across the leaf.
I stop beside a bead of dew.

lines.zh: 我把自己挤过两个叶片的缝。
lines.en: I squeeze between two leaves.

lines.zh: 橙色在绿叶上，藏也藏不住。
lines.en: Orange on a green leaf; I cannot hide.

lines.zh: 我往后缩一下，再往前拱。
lines.en: I draw back, then inch forward.

lines.zh: 我在叶面上晒着，橙得发亮。
lines.en: I bask on the leaf, orange and shining.
I eat the leaf's edge bite by bite.
My body is like a piece of thin cord.
I bury my head in the leaf.

lines.zh: 叶脉下面凉，我挪了过去。
lines.en: It's cooler under the vein. I shifted there.
A beetle passed. I made room.

lines.zh: 我这身橙色，大概很难藏。
lines.en: This orange of mine is hard to hide.

lines.zh: 我的背上没有花纹，只有亮。
lines.en: No pattern on my back. Only shine.

lines.zh: 我停下来，等叶子不再摇。
lines.en: I wait for the leaf to stop moving.

lines.zh: 我把身体卷成一个松圈。
lines.en: I curl into a loose ring.

lines.zh: 我在这儿已经吃了两天。
lines.en: I've been eating here two days.

lines.zh: 露水顺着叶脉流到我这边。
lines.en: Dew runs down the vein to me.

lines.zh: 你手心的影子把我盖住了。
lines.en: Your palm's shadow covers me.

lines.zh: 我抬起身子，橙得很显眼。
lines.en: I rear up, orange and obvious.

lines.zh: 你看我这么久，想干什么？
lines.en: You've watched me this long. What for?

lines.zh: 我这身颜色，是给鸟看的。
lines.en: My color is a warning for birds.
Don't touch the stem. It'll break.

lines.zh: 你比这片叶子大太多了。
lines.en: You're so much bigger than this leaf.

lines.zh: 我缩了一半，另一半还在看。
lines.en: Half of me pulled back; the other half still watches.
I'm not poisonous. Don't get ideas.

lines.zh: 你踩下来，这片叶就完了。
lines.en: Step down and this leaf is done for.
When the wind blows I sway and can't grip.
I roll into a tight ring.
That locked me up for a moment.
A dent in my skin.
I hang on silk, clear of the ground.

lines.zh: 我掉到下面的叶上，还好。
lines.en: I fell onto the leaf below. Not too bad.
A little sap seeps out.
Two of my legs won't answer.
I stay still and wait.
Hurt this small, I can still eat.
I shrink back toward the stem.

lines.zh: 那片嫩叶，正好在我前面。
lines.en: A tender leaf, right ahead of me.

lines.zh: 你手上那片，闻起来很新。
lines.en: The one in your hand smells new.
I'll go over and see. In no hurry.
Lower the leaf and I can reach.
I'm hungry, and I eat only leaves.
Wave it about and I lose interest.
There's water on that leaf. Must be crisp.
I sniff and turn away.
I've eaten this one thin.

lines.zh: 你在那儿等着，我自己会来。
lines.en: Wait there. I'll come on my own.

lines.zh: 你一碰，我就从叶上掉了。
lines.en: One touch and I drop off the leaf.
I hang in the air, feet still moving.
That squashed me out of shape.
Your breath bends me sideways.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的袖子，往上爬。
lines.en: I catch your sleeve and climb.
The leaf's slick; I slid back.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，橙得像个果子。
lines.en: I ball up, orange as a berry.

lines.zh: 你踩到了叶边，我赶紧退。
lines.en: You stepped on the leaf edge. I backed off.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，我弹出去一点。
lines.en: We bumped and I bounced a little.
Let me by. I need the stem.
I need to finish my leaves first.
I still have sheds to go.
Ask when I can fly.
There's no room for that on this leaf.
I shrink to the other side of the stem.

lines.zh: 我现在的颜色，是给天敌看的。
lines.en: My color is for predators, not for this.
My mind holds only eating and growing.

lines.zh: 等结蛹以后，什么都不同了。
lines.en: After the chrysalis, everything changes.
Let's not bring that up.
Just think of me as a grub.
I wrap my front half around it.
I can drag this leaf scrap.

lines.zh: 这滴水太重，我只喝一半。
lines.en: The drop's too heavy. I drink half.
I push it along in front of my head.
I bite it and shift backward.
I go around that grain of sand.
I lift it and it slips.

lines.zh: 地上有片枯叶，我爬上去。
lines.en: A dead leaf on the ground. I climb on.
Too hard. I can't push it.
This grass stem will do as a bridge.
That leaf is just the right shade.
There's a patch nothing has chewed.

lines.zh: 我看见那条枝通到那边。
lines.en: I see that twig leads across.

lines.zh: 这片叶的边太硬，我不吃。
lines.en: This leaf's edge is tough. Not for me.

lines.zh: 那片叶上有水光，很新鲜。
lines.en: There's sheen on that leaf. Fresh.

lines.zh: 我减慢了一点，想清楚路线。
lines.en: I slow to work out the route.

lines.zh: 有只鸟在上面，我不敢动。
lines.en: A bird's above. I don't dare move.
The sun's moved. This spot will cool.
I want the highest tender leaf.

lines.zh: 我抬头，把身子尽量伸出去。
lines.en: I lift my head and stretch as far as I can.
My front half goes first.
I work along the leaf's edge.
About a finger's width to go.
The leaf's moving. I'll wait.

lines.zh: 我从叶背绕过去，更安全。
lines.en: I'll go via the underside. Safer.
I pause and recheck the way.
That vein's firm enough to cross.

lines.zh: 我半条身子已经过去了。
lines.en: Half of me is across already.
I inch along. I won't fall.
One more segment and I'm there.
I bite your fingertip. Lightly.
I bump your hand with my whole body.
My jaws can't break skin.
I wrap your finger. Can't hold.
The moment I bite, my feet lose their grip.
I climb back and bite again.

lines.zh: 我吐出一点汁，弄湿了你。
lines.en: I spit a little sap and wet you.
After the blow I hang at the leaf's edge and puff.
Back off and I'll stop.

lines.zh: 我落在你的鞋上，橙得显眼。
lines.en: I land on your shoe, bright orange.

lines.zh: 我从叶下钻出来，一身橙。
lines.en: I come out from under the leaf, all orange.

lines.zh: 这片叶的背面是我的窝。
lines.en: The back of this leaf is my nest.
I've just crawled out of that egg.

lines.zh: 雨把我从上面那片叶冲下来。
lines.en: Rain washed me down from the leaf above.

lines.zh: 丛林里的嫩叶多，我留下了。
lines.en: Plenty of tender leaves here. I'll stay.

lines.zh: 我在这条枝上吃了三天。
lines.en: I've eaten on this twig three days.

lines.zh: 风把我吹到了这片叶上。
lines.en: The wind blew me onto this leaf.

lines.zh: 我蜕了一次皮，颜色更深了。
lines.en: I shed once and my color deepened.
The holes in this leaf are mine.
I creep up onto this new leaf.

lines.zh: 叶子卷了，我的皮也烫得发皱。
lines.en: The leaf curls and my skin puckers with heat.

lines.zh: 我从叶上掉下去，落进草里。
lines.en: I fall off the leaf into the grass.

lines.zh: 水把我的气孔堵住了，我扭着。
lines.en: Water clogs my spiracles and I twist.

lines.zh: 气浪把叶子撕开，我飞了出去。
lines.en: The blast tears the leaf apart and throws me.

lines.zh: 有根尖东西扎穿叶片，紧挨着我。
lines.en: A sharp thing pierces the leaf just beside me.

lines.zh: 我贴在叶上，被一股力压住。
lines.en: I'm pressed to the leaf by a force.

lines.zh: 叶子吃光了，我软得爬不动。
lines.en: The leaf's gone and I'm too weak to crawl.

lines.zh: 雷打中枝头，我整条抽了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hits the twig and my body jerks.

lines.zh: 叶子没了，我一段一段落下去。
lines.en: The leaf's gone and I fall, segment by segment.
